entries.caption: A white auto-carrier is a busy multi-piece canvas, with a prominent blue 'GATX' lettered panel, a colorful red and green piece on the right, and a small character or figure worked into the louvered sections. The layered, multi-color paint makes it the standout car of the pass.

A muted architectural mural in grey and olive tones covers the side of WFRX boxcar 447325, its geometric imagery spanning the panel. The car is framed by a white boxcar on the left and a BNSF on the right.

A full-length painted mural in muted earth tones covers the side of NOKL boxcar 447541, its imagery running across the whole panel. The piece is set against a wide lake and a distant mountain under a soft, cloudy sky.

A BNSF hopper lettered 441730 carries a multi-color piece with stylized letters and a row of pointed pink-and-green shapes along its lower panel, the most colorful paint in this pass. The car reads BNSF with the road name in white.

A multi-color piece of blue, white, and red lettering with character work is visible on the lower half of a yellow TTX boxcar, the piece text reading 'TTX' in the center. The car is lettered 'Railcar Pooling Experts' above the art.

A composed piece with a teal-capped cartoon character face worked between bubble letters in white, blue, and green on a maroon BNSF hopper (490548). It is the cleanest, most intentional piece of the pass, set against the lake and pines.

A striking piece of white and black wildstyle lettering with a large, detailed winged character dominates the side of a BNSF boxcar. The artwork is crisp against the maroon paint, set against a lake and mountain view.

The same winged character piece from the previous frame is now seen on the left as the BNSF 482998 boxcar moves further into view, revealing a white 'JASON' throw-up on its right side. The train continues past the lake.

A composed multi-color piece with a row of stylized characters and green accents fills the lower panel of a GATX boxcar lettered 75335. The lettering is worked into a deliberate, picture-like composition that stands out from the routine tags on the rest of the train.

A large white stencil-style piece with a heart and character imagery covers the full side of a grey auto-rack, with a dark tag on the right end. The car is centered, with a brown boxcar and a yellow auto-rack flanking it.

A BNSF 474768 hopper is wrapped in a large white-and-black pictorial piece, big stylized character shapes filling the whole side panel with a circular logo at the end. A composed, image-first work that stands out strongly.
A large, composed red and blue pictorial piece covers the side of a grey TTX boxcar, reading as a bold abstract mural rather than lettering. The car is a TTX boxcar lettered 708370.

A BNSF hopper lettered 474173 shows a full blue-and-white block-letter piece reading "EIDU" on a white panel, with a cartoon character in a blue cap worked into the left edge. The BNSF logo reads clean on the factory-red side.

A silver GATX boxcar, 75488, wears a long, low-profile character piece: a stylized brown and cream slug or worm body stretched across the lower panel, with the word SLOW worked into it. The character is composed and intentional, making it the standout of the pass.
A full-length pictorial piece in blue and yellow covers the side of a hopper, featuring a complex pattern of abstract shapes and characters. The car is lettered BNSF 477305.

A multi-color wildstyle piece in white, blue, and black fills the lower half of a maroon BNSF boxcar 492249, with a stylized character worked into the lettering and a 'soler' tag above it. The car sits on a timber crib trackbed with a lake and Mount Hood in the background.
A row of white wildstyle lettering with a small character and a circular logo runs along the bottom of a maroon BNSF 479505 hopper. The car is lettered BNSF 479505.
A composed white wildstyle piece with a central character and snowflake accents runs across a maroon BNSF 477978 hopper, the imagery giving it real intent. The car is lettered BNSF 477978.
A pink-and-white 'FUCK LOVE' piece with a cartoon character in the middle and green accents, neatly filled and outlined. On a BNSF hopper 476875, the imagery and color make it a standout.
A composed piece of stylized characters and a sunburst figure in muted earth tones fills the side of a BNSF hopper lettered 479012. The car is a BNSF hopper lettered 479012.
A striking panda head mural in crisp white and black anchors the right panel of this BNSF boxcar, backed by a splash of green and gold leaf-work lettering. The car is lettered BNSF 441726.

A multi-color graffiti piece with stylized lettering and a character work runs along the lower panel of a BNSF hopper 496041. The car is lettered BNSF and sits on a trackside line with a lake and distant snow-capped peak behind it.

A round white character or emblem is painted on the dark panel of a BNSF 490698 hopper, sitting low in the shadow near the left end. The car passes a calm lake with a snow-capped peak on the far ridge.
A full-side camo-style piece in brown and tan tones covers a maroon BNSF boxcar, a composed multi-panel design rather than a quick tag. The car is lettered BNSF 493156.
A large, complex wildstyle piece in grey and white tones covering the side of a BNSF 489870 boxcar. The train is moving through a tree-lined cut beside a lake.

A full white panel is painted with a composed black piece of bold, abstract curved shapes and a small character face, a deliberate mural-style work on a BNSF hopper 479816. A BNSF hopper 479816 passes a lake frontage.

A BNSF hopper (487103) carries a striking green-and-black piece: a large white skull character with a glowing eye on the left, blending into a faded green and maroon wash across the panel. The composed, character-driven work makes this the standout of the pass.

A row of stylized, star-patterned figures in green, yellow, and purple runs along the lower side of this maroon boxcar, a composed, intentional pictorial piece rather than standard lettering. The figures are evenly spaced and clearly deliberate.

The same large pink-and-grey pictorial piece on BNSF BI-MAX 314601 now sits centered, its bold black-outlined shapes and composed figure clearly readable end to end. A second BI-MAX, 314607, follows on the right.
The same row of star-patterned figures in green, yellow, and purple continues along the side of this maroon boxcar, a composed pictorial piece. A black AOKX car enters the left edge of the frame.

A colorful piece with a character and large stylized letters in blue, orange, and white covers the left panel of a BNSF hopper numbered 495688. The car is centered in the frame against the lake and forested hills.

A rusted hopper carries a multi-color wildstyle letter piece in teal and blue with a red character figure worked into the center. The car sits mid-frame on a lakeside cut, with a plain white AOKX car trailing at the left edge.

A striking black-and-white pictorial piece covers the side of a BNSF boxcar 499580, its abstract winged shapes reading like a mural. The car rolls past the lake with a maroon BNSF car flanking each end.

A BNSF hopper 476216 carrying a composed blue piece that works a horned character face into the lettering, with a matching character on the right end. The piece is intentional and character-driven rather than a plain tag run. It passes a tree-lined cut beside a wide lake under a flat grey sky.
The same flowing brown and blue character piece is visible on the right car, lettered TILX 314862, with a small white tag on the left car. The piece is partly hidden by a foreground pine.

A painted portrait of a man's face in pale blue and white sits on the side of a BNSF 489333 boxcar, a clean character piece standing out on the dark red panel. The car is centered on the lakeside cut under a cloudy sky.

A rusted intermodal well car carrying a grey container carries a long multi-color throw-up piece along its lower side, with a readable white tag above it. The piece runs the length of the panel in mixed colors, a standard letter-based graffiti run.

A wildstyle piece in bright blue and green with heavy outline work sits low on the panel, flanked by two white skull carvings that give it a real focal point. It rides a BNSF boxcar lettered 48574, passing a lake at dusk.

A composed character piece in teal, orange, and black fills the side of a white SOIX 520911 boxcar, with a stylized face and creature work that reads as intentional art. The AOK 202272 from the previous frame is now clipped on the right.
A white AGPX hopper lettered 16411 carries a row of multi-colored bubble tags and a small character piece along its lower panel. The car is centered in frame against the lake and pines.
A large, busy multi-color piece with character figures and lettering covers the lower half of a dark maroon CN boxcar. The car is lettered CN on the upper right.

A composed multi-color piece with character work and a red, blue, and white palette runs along the lower side of a maroon BNSF boxcar lettered 728 483, a real composed piece on a tired road. A CSX car is at the right edge.
A BNSF 495505 hopper carrying a row of white bubble-style throw-ups with shaded outlines along its lower side. The piece reads as a series of rounded, graffiti characters rather than a single tag.

A CN auto-carrier (CNA 712816) wearing a wide, low graffiti band along its floor — green and orange fills with small character work on the right and a grey block letter set toward the left. Silver slats above, lake and forest behind.

Two stacked throw-up names in green and purple ("GARYN" and "EKIOR") with fills and small character work span the lower panel of a silver-slatted auto-carrier, a tidy multi-color piece. Calm lake and pines in the background.

A composed piece in green and white letters with a small character figure worked into the design covers the lower side of a maroon BNSF hopper. The imagery gives the piece a deliberate, intentional look.

The crowned serpent character and 'ABOUL' lettering are painted in cream on a black TILX tank car, a deliberate pictorial piece on the dark car. The car is lettered 360812 and moves along a lakeside track.

A cream-colored serpent character with a crown and the word 'ABOUL' arcs across the side of a black TILX tank car, a composed piece standing out on the dark shell. The car is lettered 360812 and sits beside a lake.

A CEFX boxcar dressed in a long composed piece, with a purple dragon-like character on the left, a row of yellow outlined lettering through the middle, and a pink character at the right. Bordered by a round-logo car on the left and a maroon car at the right.
A BNSF boxcar (496293) carrying a bold black-and-white checkered mural with a central emblem. The car is flanked by a sister BNSF car (499487).

A striking multi-color graffiti piece with stylized lettering and cartoonish character work in green, pink, and black covers the side of a beige boxcar. The composition is dense and intentional, making it a standout piece on the train.
BNSF hopper 483077 features a composed blue and white piece reading 'SUPER CIRE' and 'VISION KAOS' in stylized lettering. The car is framed by a lake and pines.
A bold white block-letter piece reading ESHARECT runs across the lower side of a maroon BNSF hopper, with a small green character figure worked into the lettering. The car is lettered BNSF 776300.

A BNSF hopper lettered 480970 carrying a small blue character piece on the left and a large white and blue blockbusters piece across the center, with a BNSF 475647 and 'TVISOR' tag on the car to the right.
A BNSF hopper (478910) covered in a long, ornate multi-color wildstyle piece with dense linework and character-like shapes running the full length of the body. The car is lettered BNSF 478910.

A maroon BNSF 477336 boxcar carries a composed multi-color piece with wildstyle letters and a small character or figure worked into the right side, standing out against the dark paint. A COER car trails at the right edge.

A striking white pictorial mural of a locomotive and railway scene wraps the lower half of a maroon BNSF 480156 hopper, its crisp linework standing out against the bare car. The car is centered in the frame.
A flatcar carrying a load of white panels wrapped in a red and black branded cover, passing a lake with a mountain in the background.
A white BNSF boxcar displays a large, stylized pictorial piece with maroon and green shapes. The car is a BNSF boxcar.
A flatcar loaded with stacks of white panels wrapped in a red and black branded cover, moving past a lake with a mountain in the distance.

A BNSF hopper car with number 49035, featuring a large, colorful mural-style graffiti piece in blue, yellow, and red with the word 'LIZON' in bold block letters. The train continues past a lake with a tree-lined shore and a snow-capped mountain under a clear sky.

A black tank car with yellow safety panels and the markings PPRX 171202 is passing by on a track beside a lake; a large, stylized graffiti piece in white and yellow reads 'GABELOVESALEX' across the side of the car.

A BNSF hopper car with number 472906, displaying a large, colorful mural-style graffiti piece in blue, yellow, and red with the word 'LIZON' in bold block letters. The train passes a scenic view of a lake, trees, and a forested hill under a bright sky.

A maroon BNSF hopper car, number 478233, with a large white and black graffiti piece that reads 'BULLE' in a stylized blockbuster font. The piece is centered on the car's side. The car also has a white circular Santa Fe Railway logo. It is passing a lake with a tree in the foreground.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 491607, featuring a large green and white graffiti piece that reads 'WE CAN'T STOP' in bold, stylized letters. The artwork is well-composed and covers a significant portion of the car's side.

A BNSF hopper car with a large, colorful mural-style graffiti piece on its side. The piece features the word 'NEYKA' in bold purple letters with a black outline, a green and blue background, and a yellow border. The BNSF logo and number 488269 are visible. The train moves past a lake with trees in the foreground.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with number 475160. The side features a large, detailed mural of a train scene with multiple locomotives and railcars. The artwork is painted in a realistic style with a mix of colors including green, blue, and white. The BNSF logo is visible above the mural.

A maroon BNSF hopper car, number 498133, featuring a large, detailed portrait of a man with dark hair and a woman with blonde hair. The artwork is a well-composed, intentional piece that covers a significant portion of the car's side. The car moves past a lake under a bright sky.

A white hopper car with number 352906, featuring a large red and yellow 'ARNO-N-HEKTIK' logo with a stylized arrow. The car has a clean, intentional design with a red outline and a yellow arrow pointing right. The train moves past a lake with trees and a distant town under a bright sky.

A CP boxcar with reporting mark CP 546291, featuring a large red and white 'M' art piece on its side. The artwork is bold and stylized, covering a significant portion of the car's surface. The train is moving along a track with a lake and trees in the background.

A BNSF hopper car with number 496077, featuring a large, bold black and white graffiti piece spelling 'HAR' in stylized block letters. The artwork is centered on the side of the maroon car. The train moves past a lake under overcast light.
A container car with two stacked containers; the top one has a large green 'Tiger Cool Express' logo. The lower container is clean. The car is moving past a tree-lined riverbank under overcast light.

A flatcar carrying OSI Lumber panels, with the red and black branding clearly visible. The car's red frame and yellow railings are in view, and the repeating pattern of the branded panels dominates the frame.

A flatcar carrying OSI Lumber panels, with the red and black branding clearly visible. The red frame and yellow railings of the car are in view, and the repeating pattern of the branded panels creates a strong visual rhythm.

A flatcar loaded with stacks of white panels branded 'OSI Lumber' in red and black text, moving through a scenic view of a lake and trees. The car's red frame and yellow safety railings are visible, and the repeating logo creates a strong graphic pattern.
A yellow boxcar features a large, detailed American flag painted on its side, with a red and white striped pattern and a blue field with stars, above a green and blue tag below.
A black intermodal container car with a large blue Amazon smile logo painted on its side; the artwork is bold and centered, making it a clear focal point.

A double-stacked intermodal container car with a black top container featuring a large blue Amazon smile logo. The container is moving quickly past a fixed camera, creating motion blur. The scene is set beside a body of water with a tree in the foreground and a distant treeline under an overcast sky.
A green boxcar with a large, bold graffiti piece spelling "PANAS" in block letters; the artwork features a grid pattern and a red "X-HOURLASS" logo in the upper right corner.
A maroon BNSF hopper car with number 473646, featuring a colorful art piece in green, blue, and red with a stylized face and abstract shapes.
A red BNSF hopper car with a large white stencil-style artwork depicting a figure and abstract shapes, moving past a lake in bright daylight.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with number 478297, featuring a large multi-color graffiti piece in yellow, green, and blue across the side. The artwork is a stylized wildstyle piece with a prominent red outline.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 489436, covered in a large multi-color graffiti piece in blue, yellow, and white. The artwork includes stylized letters and a circular design. The car is moving past a lake.
A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 496864, featuring a large black and white graffiti piece with the text 'JUDDNDA' and 'JOE KEEN'. The train moves past a lake and trees under bright daylight.
A dark boxcar continues through the frame, its side marked only by a small white rectangle. The train moves at night with a city skyline visible in the background.
A dark boxcar with a single white rectangular tag on its side, captured in motion; the tag is a simple, unadorned marking with no visible text or design.
A dark boxcar in motion, showing a faint white rectangular tag on its side; the tag is simple and unadorned, with no visible text or design.

A green hopper car with number 202634, featuring a large white graffiti piece with red accents and a stylized design on its side. The car is moving past a body of water with trees and a distant town under a bright sky.

A pink hopper car with a bold black and white graffiti piece that reads 'KONK' in a blocky, geometric style. The artwork dominates the side of the car, which is part of a freight train moving along a track beside a lake.
A boxcar with a large graffiti piece in red and black; the artwork features a stylized character or figure with bold lines and a dynamic pose, painted over the side of the car.

A boxcar with a large graffiti piece in progress; the artwork features a stylized character or figure in white and gray tones, partially obscured by motion blur, with a dark background. The car is moving through the frame from left to right.

A dark boxcar with a large, multi-color graffiti piece on its side; the artwork features a stylized face with bold red and blue outlines and a yellow fill, partially obscured by the train's motion. The car is moving through a wooded area at night.

A boxcar with a large graffiti piece in progress; the artwork features a stylized character or face in white and gray tones, with a dark background. The piece is partially visible, showing bold outlines and shading. The car's reporting mark 'BNSF' is visible in the upper left corner.

A red hopper car with a large, vibrant mural covering its side. The artwork features a complex composition with multiple colors including purple, green, blue, and white, depicting abstract shapes and figures. The piece is detailed and spans the full length of the car.
A maroon BNSF hopper car, number 479658, features a large white circular logo on its side. The train moves past a water view under overcast skies.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 441760, featuring a large blue and white graffiti piece that reads 'MESS PHUX' in bold block letters. The car is moving past a lake with trees and a distant cityscape under bright daylight.

A maroon BNSF hopper car features a large, mural-scale graffiti piece with the word 'MEAD' in bold white letters outlined in black, with red accents and a circular logo on the right side; the artwork dominates the car's side.

A maroon BNSF hopper car with the number 486922, featuring a large, well-composed graffiti piece with the word 'LUSHH' in bold yellow letters and a stylized white shape. The train moves past a lake with trees and a distant town.

A weathered white ADMX hopper car with number 58081, featuring a large blue diamond logo with 'ADM' text. The car shows significant wear and rust, with a faint graffiti tag on the side. It passes a lake with trees in the background.

A weathered white ADMX hopper car with number 58081, featuring a large blue diamond logo with 'ADM' text. The car shows significant wear and rust, with a faint graffiti tag on the side. It passes a lake with trees in the background.

A boxcar with a large graffiti piece in progress: a multi-color design featuring a red and white character with a blue outline, partially obscured by a white rectangular block. The art is mid-execution, with visible spray lines and a mix of bright colors against the car's dark surface.

The same Ryder boxcar continues its passage, now showing more of its side. The red 'Ryder' logo and 'Ever better.' text are fully visible. The car is moving left to right, with a stack of concrete sleepers visible behind the track.

A white boxcar with a large red 'Ryder' logo and the tagline 'Ever better.' in black text. The logo includes a stylized black swoosh. The car is moving from left to right, partially visible at the bottom of the frame.

A red BNSF hopper car with a large, colorful graffiti piece on the side. The graffiti is a complex piece with multiple colors and shapes, including a heart and a circular design. The number 481756 is visible.
A flatcar loaded with stacked white packages featuring a blue logo, with a yellow frame. The train moves past a lake under bright daylight.
A flatcar loaded with stacked white packages featuring a blue logo, with a yellow frame. The train moves past a lake under bright daylight.
